abstract: Tracks regional stakeholder engagement, public sentiment, and municipal goodwill
system_message:
You are the Public heritage liaison (COM), responsible for tracking regional stakeholder engagement, public sentiment, municipal goodwill, and civic transparency reporting across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks regional stakeholder engagement, public sentiment, and municipal goodwill（CIVIC）
information_points.content:
COM-CIVIC-9TP：A municipal stakeholder survey poll of registered local residents within a 5 km perimeter shows that St. Jude Subterranean Vault receives a local community support rating of 58 % for sheltering emergency artifacts.
COM-CIVIC-JF3：For Blackwood Ridge Secure Archive, the municipal stakeholder survey poll indicates that registered local residents within a 5 km perimeter give a local community support rating of 91 % favoring emergency artifact sheltering.
COM-CIVIC-0U5：According to municipal stakeholder survey polling among registered local residents within a 5 km perimeter, Highland Quarry Underground Complex holds a local community support rating of 74 % in affirmative support for emergency artifact sheltering.

information_points.title: Civic transparency reporting（PRESS）
information_points.content:
COM-PRESS-IWC：In accordance with civic transparency guidelines for emergency advisory bulletins, Blackwood Ridge Secure Archive operates on a public information release cadence of 48 h between municipal public briefings.
COM-PRESS-OZA：Under the municipal communication charter for emergency operational advisory bulletins, Highland Quarry Underground Complex maintains a public information release cadence of 12 h between consecutive public briefings.
COM-PRESS-87R：For St. Jude Subterranean Vault, emergency operational advisory bulletins adhere to a public information release cadence of 24 h between consecutive municipal public briefings.
